data.title: Corporación América Airports Posts September Traffic Growth as International Demand Strengthens
data.description:

On October 16, 2026, Corporación América Airports reported that passenger traffic across its network rose 3.4% year-on-year in September 2026, with international and transit flows offsetting a slight domestic decline. Year-to-date traffic was up 2.5%, while cargo volume grew modestly and aircraft movements were broadly flat, underscoring steady operational momentum despite mixed regional trends.

Argentina hit a record September for total passengers, supported by recovering domestic demand and stronger long-haul routes to Europe and Miami, even after Flybondi’s exit, while Italy and Armenia posted robust growth, particularly in international traffic. Brazil was the main laggard with a 1.7% traffic drop, but new routes and planned frequency increases in Brazil, Uruguay, Ecuador, and Armenia point to expanding connectivity that should support future volumes and strengthen CAAP’s competitive position in key regional hubs.
